title: CADGuide Engineering Specifications & Algorithmic Toolset
description: Comprehensive mathematical derivations, binary format specifications, and queueing models for modern CAD/CAM/BIM engineering. Includes zero-server client-side DWG header validation algorithms, DIN 6935 compliant sheet metal bend allowance formulas, and Poisson-distributed concurrent network license pooling models. Full interactive tools and live calculators available at https://cadguide.tools.
